@description:
 [Vocational] A mother is just that—a female parent. Normally, only a female
 character of reproductive age (and with a child) may choose to take this
 training package. However, a GM may wish to allow any parent to take this
 package. The GM may decide that the training time varies according to the
 character's race and culture. Mothers often adventure when seeking to recover
 their lost children. Time to Acquire: 9 months. Starting Money: normal.
